usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts, and Emaillistverify checks the shopper's address through “Verify Email” after an “Abandoned Checkout”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Verify Email” in Emaillistverify
bestTemplate.why: It checks deliverability before you chase a shopper who never finished, so follow-ups reach a real inbox.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the check runs after a scheduled pass, not as the shopper leaves.
